svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.1.3 Items under Part 3 Jurisdiction
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Items under Part 3 Jurisdiction

g.text: Floor opening not protected by a

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Tents, air-supported structures, transformer vaults, walkways,
elevators and escalators conform to Part 3
Rooms or spaces intended for an assembly occupancy conform to
Part 3
Basements containing more than 1 storey or exceeding 600 m²
(6 458 ft²) in area conform to Part 3
Rooms or spaces for the storage, manufacture or use of hazardous
or explosive material conform to Part 3
Except as provided in Article 3.3.5.8., facilities for the
dispensing of fuel are not installed in any building
Openings through floors not protected by shafts or closures are
protected in conformance with Subsection 3.2.8.
See also Sentence 9.9.4.7.(1).
Chutes and shafts conform to Subsection 3.6.3., except where
entirely contained within a dwelling unit
Sprinkler systems: Articles 3.2.5.12. to 3.2.5.15. and 3.2.5.17.
Standpipe and hose systems: Articles 3.2.5.8. to 3.2.5.11. and
Fire pumps: Articles 3.2.5.17. and 3.2.5.18.
Fuel-fired appliances installed on a roof: Article 3.6.1.5.
Drawn: a composite section, near side open, so every handover to Part 3 shows in one view. It is not a single real design.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.1.3. (page 9-59)
